warning_texts: No machine rule reads the caveat text in analysis/answers/*.json. questions_are_answered checks only that question and facts exist, so causal or unsupported wording in an answer can be caught only by this auditor or by wording_matches_claims at release.

check_plan caveats_declared asks CLM-AOV-* only for channel-population and sampling-interval topics. The delivered-only and net-of-refunds wording for AOV is therefore checked by no deterministic rule.

Both test p-values are stored as 0.0000000000 (true values are around 1e-150). A surface that shows them at display_digits 4 would print a p of zero. Rendering them as below 0.0001 would be more honest.

Both tests declare alpha 0.05 with a Bonferroni correction, but neither the register nor the answers state the adjusted per-test threshold of 0.025. The conclusion does not change because both p-values are far below it.

The CLM-COMPLETION-* caveats do not say in words that cancelled and pending orders are in the denominator. The recount confirms they are: direct 24597 = all direct orders, partner 19934 = all partner orders.

recompute_estimate, recompute_test and min_group_size read clean_data/orders_clean.csv, not raw. Only claims_recomputed goes back to the raw export. This auditor's recompute from the quarantine projection agrees with all of them.
The unpublished shipping_total (37792722.50 EUR in metrics) was not recomputed here. R05's roughly-six-per-cent unreadable share was confirmed: 2648 of 44531 population orders are blank, NaN or inf.
summary: All eight claims recompute independently from quarantine/orders.csv (last revision per order_id, Q1 by order_month, negative refunds excluded: 44531 orders) and match metrics, plan and the machine gate exactly; no Simpson reversal by country or month. Three text blockers on worker_analysis: R04 attributes the AOV gap causally to channel and customer price sensitivity, which the data cannot support; both CLM-AOV-* caveats omit that the figure is delivered-only and net of refunds; R03/R04 hypothesis blocks omit the registered groups.
